heading_path: Part 9—Removal of trade mark from Register for nonuse
text: (1) If an application has been made to the Registrar under section 92, the Registrar must give a copy of the application in accordance with the regulations. (2) If the application is in respect of a trade mark already entered on the Register, the Registrar must publish the application in accordance with the regulations. (3) If the application is in respect of a trade mark whose registration is being sought, the Registrar is to publish the application in accordance with the regulations only if the trade mark is registered.
